making mixed classes are harder to make viable. generally, only few races have the speed, damage and infinites to melee efficiently, and strike and ki blast moves depend on race and gender. generally, people don't go below 70 in an attacking stat.

usually, 70 points in hp or above is a must. (remember, you can wish for "i wish to look drop dead gorgeous" to reset character height and weight, with shenron. though not name, gender or race) (and you can wish "i wish for a second chance at life" to reset stat attribute points. to collect the dragonballs the easiest, solo pq02, defeat yamcha, krillin and tien. if a timepatroller appears in kami palace doorway, fight him, and get last hit on him. it should give two messages. the first one is "got material item". the second is either another material item. if it is, restart mission, if it's "got key item", continue mission and beat it to get the dragonball, even if a ultimate encounter happens, it's faster to beat it than to loose to it. repeat.)

stamina is very important on all characters. not only is the regen rate tied to max stamina, but even if you're good at evading, using evasives, or not blocking when guard broken, or vanishing while blocking to save stamina, it's always important. usually not above 70 though.

ki is useful in a number of ways. especially on strike and ki blasters. usually not above 70 points. on a melee character however, it's completely useless, unless it's sorta a mixed/utility build, that finishes off with something fast like final flash (since blast attacks are by proxy better than strike attacks)

on clothes, it's a bit different. there's alot of different stat combination on clothes. alot of good clothes are majin or frieza or namekian specific.

clothes are percentage modifiers.

hp percentage modifiers on clothes is bad, but for a ki blaster "gt goku gi" or "4 star gi" is better than nothing.

ki blast, strike supers and basic attack modifiers are good, a must.

and ki and stamina modifiers are AWESOME! (meaning that having clothes that gives plus in that is good, but minus in it is a no-no)

there is of course also things like beerus clothes for mixed classes.
